# Exchange component metadata uses Networking consistently across build and ownership export

The historical patch changes the Exchange Bugzilla component from Network: Exchange to Networking: Exchange in the two build declarations and module-ownership config/export. It also adds jtracey as a module peer. The pinned accepted source retains the corrected string but has later owner/path additions; do not copy historical ownership as current. Config and generated export are one evidence chain. This is source classification metadata, with no runtime Exchange behavior or generator execution proved.

Scope: exchange-component-metadata.
